reasons.dense: The provider identity maps to an existing dense Aptus family; the planner still decides the executable runtime and method.
reasons.four_bit: The first Qwen3 MoE MLX-LM contract requires explicit four-bit model metadata.
reasons.identity: MoE execution requires the exact reviewed qwen3_moe and Qwen3MoeForCausalLM provider identity.
reasons.invalid: Model compatibility facts are malformed or contradictory.
reasons.layout: Qwen3 MoE execution requires the exact four-bit plus eight-bit router-gate MLX quantization layout.
reasons.matched: The model identity, mixed-precision layout, routed-expert topology, and attention-only q/k/v/o target policy match the reviewed Qwen3 MoE slice. Measured preflight and a real-model pilot remain mandatory.
reasons.qwen2_dense: The reviewed Qwen2 MLX-LM runtime footprint requires dense topology with no MoE configuration.
reasons.qwen2_four_bit: The reviewed Qwen2 MLX-LM runtime footprint requires explicit four-bit model metadata.
reasons.qwen2_identity: Dense Qwen2 execution requires the reviewed qwen, qwen2, and Qwen2ForCausalLM provider identity.
reasons.qwen2_layers: The reviewed Qwen2 MLX-LM runtime footprint requires exactly 24 transformer layers.
reasons.qwen2_layout: The reviewed Qwen2 MLX-LM runtime footprint requires a uniform four-bit, group-size-64 quantization layout with no module overrides.
reasons.qwen2_matched: The provider identity and 24-layer dense four-bit, group-size-64 configuration match the reviewed Qwen2 MLX-LM runtime footprint. Runtime evidence remains scoped to the pinned artifact, and every execution still requires model-data, measured-preflight, and pilot validation.
reasons.shared: The first Qwen3 MoE MLX-LM contract does not support a shared expert.
reasons.sparse: Sparse model execution requires an exact reviewed model compatibility policy.
reasons.topology: Qwen3 MoE execution requires the complete provider-declared expert topology.
reasons.unknown: No exact Aptus model-family compatibility policy matches this provider model type and architecture.
